options.

changes save as you make them.

sites.

reflect asks for a reason before opening any of these.

    settings.

    minutes a site stays open after you give a good reason.

    reasons with this many words or fewer get sent back.

    what the block page asks you.

    how sure reflect needs to be that a reason is genuine. at 0% every reason gets through, at 100% none do.

    smart model.

    a small language model that understands far more words than the original. it downloads about 23 MB once, then runs on your device. if it can't load, reflect uses the original model.

    blobs.

    the shapes that drift away from your cursor on the block page.

    shaded blobs.

    gives the blobs soft 3D shading.

    how many recent reasons to keep in the list below.

    recent reasons.

    what you told reflect, newest first.

    reason site result when

    nothing yet. reasons you give on the block page show up here.
